Summary: Epic A — Scheduling UX
Description: Roadmap: publish later UI + scheduled list + card actions.
Acceptance Criteria: Epic complete when: composer sends publishedAt for future posts; SCHEDULED status used; creators see Scheduled tab; cancel/reschedule works; members do not see until publish time.

Summary: BE: Zod + service rules for publishedAt and SCHEDULED
Description: Extend createAnnouncementSchema and update paths: optional publishedAt (ISO datetime). If publishedAt > now+2min and status not DRAFT → derive SCHEDULED. PATCH: reschedule only while SCHEDULED (define forbidden transitions).
Acceptance Criteria: API returns 400 on invalid publishedAt. Creating with future publishedAt persists SCHEDULED and does not emit realtime until publish. Unit tests cover create + patch.

Summary: FE: Schedule for later in create-dialog step 2
Description: Toggle Schedule for later; datetime-local + timezone selector (default browser TZ); submit includes publishedAt; button label Schedule vs Post; toast shows scheduled local time.
Acceptance Criteria: When toggle off behavior matches current immediate publish. When on publishedAt sent and validated. Timezone sent or stored per product decision.

Summary: FE: Scheduled tab in announcement-feed (creator-only)
Description: New tab visible only to DEAN/SUPER_ADMIN (and creator). Fetches GET / with status=SCHEDULED filter (server-side once PR3 lands).
Acceptance Criteria: Tab shows only caller's scheduled posts or all scheduled in scope per spec. Empty state when none.

Summary: FE: Scheduled card badge and publish time line
Description: AnnouncementCard shows Scheduled badge and Publishes at datetime for status=SCHEDULED.
Acceptance Criteria: Badge meets non-color accessibility (icon+text). Date format consistent with app locale.

Summary: FE: Card menu — Cancel schedule and Reschedule
Description: Manage menu: Cancel schedule → PATCH status DRAFT or ARCHIVED per product pick. Reschedule → inline or modal datetime then PATCH publishedAt.
Acceptance Criteria: Actions disabled for non-managers. Success toast and list refresh.

Summary: Socket: move card from Scheduled to Live on publish
Description: On announcement:new or update when status flips to PUBLISHED remove from scheduled list client-side and add to main feed order.
Acceptance Criteria: No duplicate cards. Sort matches pinned then new then createdAt.

Summary: Epic B — Drafts + save flow
Description: Roadmap: DRAFT status UI autosave drafts tab retention.
Acceptance Criteria: Epic complete when: users can save draft without publish; list drafts; resume; badge count; stale drafts cleaned 30d.

Summary: BE: DRAFT create without fanout or publish jobs
Description: POST with status=DRAFT creates row minimal required fields; skip enqueueAnnouncementJobs and skip emitAnnouncementRealtimeEvent until publish.
Acceptance Criteria: DRAFT never appears in public feed queries. Creator can PATCH body repeatedly.

Summary: BE: GET list filter status=DRAFT scoped to createdById
Description: GET / supports status=DRAFT and returns only announcements where createdById equals current user (and role allowed).
Acceptance Criteria: Other users never receive drafts in list. Pagination works.

Summary: FE: Drafts tab and compose draft count badge
Description: Drafts tab for managers; badge on New announcement shows draft count from API or lightweight count endpoint.
Acceptance Criteria: Badge updates after save/delete draft.

Summary: FE: Debounced autosave PATCH while composing
Description: After first persist id exists; on title/content change debounce 500ms PATCH status=DRAFT with body. On close without publish trigger save once.
Acceptance Criteria: No data loss on accidental close. Handles network errors with retry toast.

Summary: FE: Resume draft opens CreateDialog prefilled
Description: Click draft row loads GET /:id and hydrates create-dialog including step state if needed.
Acceptance Criteria: Edit mode clearly indicated. Images and targets restore per API contract.

Summary: BE: Cron retention drafts older than 30 days
Description: Scheduled job marks DRAFT as ARCHIVED or hard-deletes per policy; logs count.
Acceptance Criteria: Only DRAFT touched. Does not affect published posts.

Summary: Epic C — Server-side filter API
Description: Roadmap: GET query params full-text read filter indexes total count.
Acceptance Criteria: Epic complete when: feed search and filters hit server across all pages; GIN index verified.

Summary: BE: GET / query params q priority targetType dateFrom dateTo status read
Description: Extend routes.announcements list handler to parse query string and pass into Prisma where builder alongside visibility where.
Acceptance Criteria: All params optional. Invalid dates return 400.

Summary: BE: Full-text search via searchVector with ILIKE fallback
Description: When GIN index exists use plainto_tsquery; else ILIKE on title and content. Unify or deprecate duplicate GET /search if redundant.
Acceptance Criteria: Large dataset query completes under agreed SLA. No SQL injection.

Summary: BE: read filter joins AnnouncementRead for current user
Description: read=READ|UNREAD filters using read receipts for authenticated user.
Acceptance Criteria: Matches client expectations. Document semantics for SCHEDULED rows.

Summary: BE: Response totalCount for pagination UI
Description: Return total matching count in JSON body or X-Total-Count header consistent with existing pagination envelope.
Acceptance Criteria: FE can show result count and last page.

Summary: DB: Indexes status publishedAt createdBy status expiresAt isActive
Description: Prisma migration adds composite indexes per roadmap. Verify searchVector GIN.
Acceptance Criteria: migrate deploy succeeds. Explain analyze shows index use on sample queries.

Summary: FE: AnnouncementFeed uses server as source of truth for filters

Description: Replace client-only filter of loaded array with query key including filter object; refetch on change; skeleton Loading across all announcements.
Acceptance Criteria: Changing filter does not hide older matches. URL still syncs for shareable state.

Summary: BE: Optional SMS only for urgent priority
